remarks: Rare Estate Sale Opportunity in the Rowayton Beach Association  An exceptional opportunity to build your dream home in one of Rowayton's most sought-after coastal communities. Situated just steps from the water, this property offers direct access to the premier amenities of the Rowayton Beach Association.  Enjoy effortless coastal living with private beach access featuring community grills and Adirondack chairs perfectly positioned to capture sweeping views of Long Island Sound. The iconic neighborhood boathouse serves as a vibrant hub for social gatherings, as well as a convenient spot to launch your kayak or paddleboard.  Whether you are looking to design a custom seaside retreat or capitalize on a prime location, this estate sale presents a truly unmatched canvas.
